# Blogger
> Google’s blogging platform for creating, publishing, and managing blogs with customizable themes and Google integrations.

Blogger helps users publish blogs on Blogspot domains or custom domains, manage posts and pages, customize layouts and themes, and integrate with Google services. The platform also provides a REST API for programmatic blog, post, page, and comment management.

## Platform
- [Blogger Home](https://www.blogger.com/): Main product homepage for creating and publishing blogs on Blogger.
- [Create Your Blog](https://www.blogger.com/about/): Overview of Blogger features, publishing, design, and monetization capabilities.
- [Sign In](https://www.blogger.com/go/signin): Entry point for accessing Blogger dashboards and blog management tools.
- [Blogger Search](https://www.blogger.com/search): Search interface for discovering Blogger-hosted blogs and content.
- [Content Policy](https://www.blogger.com/go/contentpolicy): Blogger platform rules, prohibited content, and enforcement guidelines.

## Help Center
- [Blogger Help Center](https://support.google.com/blogger/): Central support hub for using Blogger and troubleshooting common issues.
- [Get Started with Blogger](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/1623800): Introductory guide to creating, setting up, and publishing a blog.
- [Manage Your Blog](https://support.google.com/blogger/topic/3339243): Help articles covering posts, pages, comments, and blog settings.
- [Design Your Blog](https://support.google.com/blogger/topic/3339244): Guidance for themes, layouts, gadgets, and blog appearance customization.
- [Fix a Problem](https://support.google.com/blogger/topic/3339245): Troubleshooting resources for login, publishing, and account-related issues.
- [Policies and Abuse](https://support.google.com/blogger/topic/3339248): Support content about Blogger policies, abuse reporting, and enforcement.

## Publishing Guides
- [Create a New Post](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/1623803): Steps for drafting, formatting, and publishing blog posts in Blogger.
- [Create, Edit, or Delete Pages](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/165955): Instructions for managing static pages on a Blogger site.
- [Manage Comments](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/187141): Guide to moderating, deleting, and configuring blog comments.
- [Schedule Posts](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/41373): Explains how to publish posts immediately or at a scheduled time.
- [Use Labels for Posts](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/1233386): Shows how to organize posts with labels for navigation and discovery.
- [Add Images and Videos](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/41641): Covers inserting media into posts and pages.

## Customization
- [Change Your Blog’s Theme](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/46888): Instructions for applying and switching Blogger themes.
- [Edit HTML for Your Theme](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/46870): Guide to modifying Blogger theme HTML and template code.
- [Use Layouts](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/43708): Explains arranging gadgets and page elements in blog layouts.
- [Add and Manage Gadgets](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/43710): Help for configuring sidebar and page gadgets on Blogger blogs.
- [Use a Custom Domain](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/55373): Steps for connecting a custom domain to a Blogger blog.
- [Manage Blog Settings](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/42673): Overview of permissions, privacy, publishing, and formatting settings.

## Account and Administration
- [Add or Remove Authors](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/42639): Manage blog authors, admins, and contributor permissions.
- [Control Blog Access](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/41369): Configure who can read, write, and administer a blog.
- [Import or Back Up Your Blog](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/41387): Export blog content or import posts from backup files.
- [Delete a Blog](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/41387?hl=en#delete): Instructions for permanently removing a Blogger blog.
- [Manage Multiple Blogs](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/41387?hl=en#manage): Guidance for handling more than one blog from one account.

## Developer Documentation
- [Blogger API Overview](https://developers.google.com/blogger/docs/3.0/getting_started): Introduction to the Blogger v3 API and core concepts.
- [Using the Blogger API](https://developers.google.com/blogger/docs/3.0/using): Practical guide to authenticating and making Blogger API requests.
- [Blogger API Reference](https://developers.google.com/blogger/docs/3.0/reference): Reference documentation for Blogger API resources and methods.
- [Blogs Resource](https://developers.google.com/blogger/docs/3.0/reference/blogs): API methods for retrieving blog metadata and details.
- [Posts Resource](https://developers.google.com/blogger/docs/3.0/reference/posts): API methods for listing, getting, inserting, and updating posts.
- [Pages Resource](https://developers.google.com/blogger/docs/3.0/reference/pages): API methods for managing static pages on Blogger blogs.
- [Comments Resource](https://developers.google.com/blogger/docs/3.0/reference/comments): API methods for retrieving and moderating blog comments.

## API Methods
- [blogs.get](https://developers.google.com/blogger/docs/3.0/reference/blogs/get): Retrieve a specific blog by ID.
- [posts.list](https://developers.google.com/blogger/docs/3.0/reference/posts/list): List posts for a blog with filtering and pagination options.
- [posts.get](https://developers.google.com/blogger/docs/3.0/reference/posts/get): Retrieve a single post by blog and post ID.
- [posts.insert](https://developers.google.com/blogger/docs/3.0/reference/posts/insert): Create a new post in a specified blog.
- [pages.list](https://developers.google.com/blogger/docs/3.0/reference/pages/list): List static pages for a blog.
- [comments.list](https://developers.google.com/blogger/docs/3.0/reference/comments/list): Retrieve comments for a blog or post.
- [users.get](https://developers.google.com/blogger/docs/3.0/reference/users/get): Get profile information for a Blogger user.

## Authentication
- [Authorize Requests](https://developers.google.com/blogger/docs/3.0/using#auth): Authentication requirements for accessing protected Blogger API resources.
- [Google API OAuth 2.0](https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2): OAuth 2.0 flows for accessing Google APIs on behalf of users.
- [OAuth 2.0 Scopes for Google APIs](https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2/scopes): Reference for scopes used when requesting Blogger API access.
- [Google API Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/): Create projects and credentials for Blogger API integrations.

## Feeds and Discovery
- [Atom Feeds in Blogger](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/97933): Overview of Blogger feed availability and syndication behavior.
- [Blogspot](https://www.blogspot.com/): Root Blogspot domain used for hosted Blogger blogs.
- [Blogger Profile Search](https://www.blogger.com/profile-find): Find Blogger profiles and associated public blogs.
- [Recent Posts Search](https://www.blogger.com/search?q=): Search Blogger content by query across public blogs.
